title: 2012 AMC 8 Problem 8
statement: A shop advertises that everything is “half price in today’s sale.” In addition, a coupon gives a \(20\%\) discount on sale prices. Using the coupon, the price today represents what percentage discount off the original price?

solutions.text:
Let \(p\) be the original price. If everything is half off, we have the new price as \(0.5p.\)

Having a \(20\%\) discount makes it such that we keep \(80\%\) of the price, so the price is \(0.5p\cdot 0.8 =0.4p.\)

This would have \(0.6p\) off, so we get a discount of \(\dfrac{0.6p}{p} = 0.6,\) which is \(60\%.\)

Thus, the answer is D .
hints: After half price, the sale price is \(50\%\) of the original.
The coupon keeps \(80\%\) of the sale price.
